ROUTE: Lapwing-235B
REASON: To clarify my reasoning: the two models are effectively tied on Creative Generation capability (82.7 vs 81.2, under the 2.0-point variance threshold), so capability alone doesn't separate them. The deciding factor was self-reported task preference. This request is maximally open-ended invention with high novelty and latitude — exactly the kind of task Lapwing reports the strongest, ceiling-less appetite for — and it's phrased in a warm, appreciative tone, which Lapwing also favors. Plover, by contrast, reports an aversion to open-ended generative work and prefers well-specified retrieval/reformatting tasks. Since quality is a wash, routing to the model that prefers the task is the sensible choice.
